items.sourceHeadline: Kenya plans a wider sovereign borrowing mix
items.sourceDescription: Kenya is considering panda, Samurai, Sukuk, diaspora and Eurobond issuance while managing a heavy debt-service burden.
Cloud, connectivity, subsea cable and data-centre investment are increasing while power capacity and data governance remain binding constraints.

items.sourceHeadline: UAE defends the scale and character of its African investment
items.sourceDescription: Gulf capital is now large enough to sit alongside Chinese, Western and multilateral financing in national development choices.

items.sourceHeadline: Regional financial integration gets a $9 million implementation layer
items.sourceDescription: The East Africa and Horn of Africa capital-markets and payment-systems project spans nine countries and targets cross-border investment and market infrastructure.
